raw_segments.text: His chief feeling was one of relief at the fact that it was not Smurdiakov, but Midia,
who had committed the murder, though he might have been expected to feel the opposite.
He did not want to analyze the reason for this feeling, and even felt a positive repugnance
He felt as though he wanted to make haste to forget something.

Grigory's wife, Marfa, in answer to Ivan's questions, declared that Smurdiakov had been

He was not three paces from our bed, and that although she was a sound sleeper, she waked
several times and heard him moaning.
He was moaning the whole time, moaning continually.
